about_short_description.short_description: Alinma Bank is a Saudi joint stock company that is created in conformity Royal Decree No. M/15 and Ministerial Resolution No. 42.

product.name: Personal Finance Products
product.description: Includes personal financing options such as personal loans, home financing, and car leasing to support individual financial needs.

product.name: Alinma Credit Card
product.description: A credit card product that facilitates daily purchases, multi-currency transactions, and rewards management for customers.

product.name: Current Accounts
product.description: Bank accounts for daily financial transactions, including family and education accounts, with digital account opening options.

product.name: Investment Product (Nama Product)
product.description: An investment product designed to help customers grow their savings through Sharia-compliant investment opportunities.

product.name: Savings Accounts and Programs
product.description: Includes savings accounts, instant savings, and protection and savings programs to support customer financial planning.

product.name: Alinma Digital Services
product.description: Digital banking services including the Alinma mobile app, internet banking, and digital certificates for convenient financial management.
